test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. A sits fourth to the left of D. Only two people sit between P and L. K sits to the immediate left of L. D sits fourth to the left of K. P sits at one of the positions to the right of K. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of people seated?
solution:
**Given:** A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) A sits fourth to the left of D.

2) D sits fourth to the left of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3ea838b568e7939a0afa20c062e9adbca026cc3f6e39dae2dacab2681ceef79.png] 

3) K sits to the immediate left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd19eeaee4435d47617fb1044deff1d40bd4177770054c39d9cc612a3e1faf8f.png] 

4) Only two people sit between P and L.

5) P sits at one of the positions to the right of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1f01db546ef7ff0683d4a4025caa5715f51d91ea3ed3aa8931f02f9bb465efd.png] 

Thus. according to the final arrangement, total of 13 people are seated.

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
